title: Issue-guided analogue for Confirmed-Request-PDU
purpose: Recover the historically sensitive structure, state, or field interaction from the issue while replacing the concrete crash trigger with a safer valid analogue.

messages.label: malformed UCOV analogue - safe tag decoding

expected_behavior: Decoder accepts the malformed extended application length but produces safe parse without out-of-bounds access or SEGV on bacapp_decode_application_data / bacapp_decode_data / host_n_port_decode / bacnet_tag_number_decode path
constraints_preserved: BVLC length field must be exactly 0x0000000f
NPDU priority, network, destination address ordering preserved
APDU service choice 0x01 (SubscribeCOV) + property-value tag structure
APDU byte count and order rules intact
issue_safety_notes: All inferred assumptions documented in constraints_preserved; no copy of original crash payload bytes used
